meta.label: GPCompaRe database statistics

sources.numbering: Residue segments and generic numbers: the full GPCRdb numbering (GPCRdb API fetched 2026-10-18). With it, 274 receptors carry an above-threshold contact at 3.50x50.
sources.cfr_set: The class-wide CFR set: the 50 top-ranked positions by CFR score.
sources.metadata: Ligand type and family from class_A_all.csv, as on the browse page.

meta.threshold_rule: Per receptor, contact pairs with |ΔRRCS| at or above mean + SD of |ΔRRCS| (at least 0.2), the threshold each report uses.
meta.sign: ΔRRCS = active minus inactive. Positive (red): stronger in the active model. Negative (blue): stronger in the inactive model.

states.1: residue numbered at this position, no above-threshold contact
states.0: no residue numbered at this position in this receptor

meta.net: Signed sum of the above-threshold ΔRRCS of the contacts touching the residue; a sum can hide opposing changes.
meta.table_note: table_n_receptors is the receptor count of the ranked CFR table (full GPCRdb residue maps); columns[].n_hit is the count with each receptor's own numbering.
